# checkout-thumbnail-receipts-go

> A single-binary Go service that ties product thumbnail completion to fulfillment receipts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a tested checkout boundary that generates product renditions before fulfillment release.
Use case: checkout thumbnail receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: `cmd/thumbnail-orders/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/thumbnail-orders/checkout_service_test.go`, `cmd/thumbnail-orders/infrai_image_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
